description: SIRE invoice validation rules. Extraction refers to invoiceSchema.json to know which fields to pull from a PDF; once a normalized draft exists, validation refers to this file to decide the invoice type, the processing status, and the exception messages. All ingest channels (Gmail, WhatsApp, Manual Upload) share these rules.

capture.rule: Every invoice is captured and loaded into the tables, even when validation fails.

status.then: Ready (promoted by the readiness job when the supplier/project are active and lines reconcile)

linesTolerance.rule: sum(line amounts) must be within max(absolute, relative * |header total|) of the header total

checks.message: Amount due is not a valid non-zero number.
Supplier "{value}" does not match any supplier in the ERP feed.
Duplicate invoice "{value}": the same supplier already has this invoice number on an invoice that is not Ready or Approved.
Invoice number was not found on the PDF; temporary number "{value}" was assigned. Verify the PDF and correct it.
A line amount is not numeric.
Invoice header amount {header} does not match the lines total {lines}.
